blind.description: A decorative altarpiece or statuette consisting of a circular tiered pedestal base with a black accent ring, a short turned stem, and an upward-curving crescent moon cradle holding a central spherical pearl or golden orb. All surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solid with a polished brass and pearlescent metallic finish.
blind.from_above: A central round golden sphere framed by two tapering crescent tips stretching to either side atop a circular base, casting a claw-like shadow.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: a thin black accent band around the base tier
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall) and about 8 inches wide.
